name: D-pad Tools
author: guipegoraro
description: Controller shortcuts. D-pad left saves a spot, right returns to it. D-pad up/down raises or lowers push speed (ignored while LB is held, which keeps the native session marker). Disable Native Trainer: only one mod can own trainer tuning.

push_step.label: Push speed step
push_step.description: How much each D-pad up/down press changes the push multiplier.

push_power.label: Scale push power too
push_power.description: Also multiply how hard each push accelerates, not only the maximum pushable speed.

show_hud.label: Show HUD
show_hud.description: Show the current push multiplier and D-pad hints on screen. Short press notices still appear when off.
